fresh_partition_design.note: No fresh document may be read, OCRed, or inspected before the protocol freeze and the pre-confirmatory reviews pass.
fresh_partition_design.ocr: only the frozen fresh documents, all four engines, versions hashed
fresh_partition_design.selection_rule: to be frozen in docs/cgv3/protocol.md before any fresh OCR
fresh_partition_design.source_pool: funsd untouched documents (training remainder + testing split)

cord.note: Fresh CORD material requires a manifest amendment pinning the train/dev parquet checksums before download; the local test extract is derived-layer-cleaned and fully consumed either way.
cord.shipped_split: test (100 documents, fully consumed by the corpus)

funsd.note: Never OCRed, aligned, inspected, or tuned on. The corpus consumed sorted(training_data)[:100]; these are the remainder plus the whole testing split.

ocrd_sbb.note: Further upstream volumes exist, but OCR-D-SBB is the frozen historical/model-availability stress track and is excluded from fresh confirmatory headline material by the benchmark design.
